overview.description: Revenue, credit volume, scans and platform adoption.
overview.failureForbidden: This account cannot enter the console. It needs to be a platform superuser.
overview.failureNetwork: The backend did not answer. Check that it is running and that the panel knows where it is.
overview.failureOther: The request returned an unexpected error.
overview.failureServer: The backend failed while building the summary. Check its log: the detail is below.
overview.failureSession: Your session expired. Sign in again to stay in the console.
overview.failureUnknown: It is not known why it failed. Press Retry; if it keeps happening, check the backend log.
overview.title: Global overview

metrics.mrrHint: Credits bought with payment since the first of the month. Welcome bonuses and admin adjustments do not count as revenue.
metrics.revenueTotalHint: Everything bought with payment since launch, in dollars.
metrics.creditsSoldHint: Sum of the credits granted by purchases, without subtracting what was spent.
metrics.pentestRunsHint: Scans launched across the platform, including the failed ones: a summary counting only successes would hide exactly the ones that break.
metrics.activeTenantsHint: Workspaces neither deleted nor deactivated. Deleted ones still count in every other metric.
metrics.totalUsersHint: Every account created, including those of deleted tenants.

health.title: Infrastructure health
health.caption: Live probe of the data dependencies.

organizations.title: Registered organizations
organizations.caption: Every tenant on the platform, with its plan and credit balance.

tenants.title: Organizations / Tenants
tenants.description: Every workspace on the platform, with its plan, balance and state.

planModal.title: Change plan of {{name}}
planModal.caption: Downgrading does not touch the balance. The workspace keeps its credits and will stop being able to spend them once it hits the plan limit.
planModal.label: Target plan

grantModal.title: Grant credits to {{name}}
grantModal.caption: The entry is recorded as an admin adjustment, never as a purchase, so it is not counted as revenue in the global overview.
grantModal.amountHint: Positive numbers only, up to four decimal places.
grantModal.noteHint: Not shown on the customer invoice. It records why this was done.

deactivateModal.title: Deactivate {{name}}
deactivateModal.caption: Deletion is logical: neither the workspace, nor its scans, nor its invoices are erased. Access is revoked and an entry is written to the audit trail.
deactivateModal.warning: This action cannot be undone from the console.

pricing.title: Negotiated prices
pricing.motiveRequired: Write a reason before agreeing a price.

states.error: The negotiated prices could not be loaded.

current.title: What is charged today
current.help: The negotiated price sits on top of the platform price. With nothing agreed, both columns match.

chain.title: History of agreed prices
chain.help: Nothing is deleted: each new agreement replaces the previous one and both stay with their reason and their author. Which one is in force is marked by the server, not by this screen.
chain.empty: This organization has no agreed price: it pays the platform price.

form.title: Agree a price
form.help: It replaces the one in force, if there is one. This is a commitment, so it is written with your name and cannot be edited afterwards.
form.motiveHelp: Required. Quote reference, customer name, whatever it takes to know where the number came from.
form.fromHelp: Empty means right now. Set a future date to agree a rise that starts at the renewal.

actions.replaced: Price agreed: the previous one stops applying
actions.error: The price could not be agreed.

users.title: Users
users.description: Every registered account and the workspaces it belongs to.

confirm.title: Disable {{name}}?
confirm.caption: The account will no longer be able to sign in. Its scan, finding and billing history is kept, and it can be enabled again.

confirmReactivate.title: Enable {{name}}?
confirmReactivate.caption: The account will be able to sign in again with its current credentials.

messages.error: The account could not be updated

sales.title: Sales and revenue
sales.description: History of the payment events processed by the payment provider.
sales.empty: No payment has been processed yet
sales.totalCaption: The sum covers this page's recorded amounts, not the full history.

kpi.eventsHint: Full platform history, not just this page.
kpi.pageScopedHint: Sum of the page being viewed, not of the history.
kpi.mrrHint: Computed over the whole history, grouped by month. It lives in the Global Overview because this query is per page.

audit.title: Global audit
audit.description: Append-only trail of everything that happened on the platform.

states.error: The console could not be loaded

forbidden.title: Insufficient privileges
forbidden.description: This console is reserved for platform superusers

actions.costInputAria: Base input cost of {{modelId}}, in dollars per million tokens
actions.costOutputAria: Base output cost of {{modelId}}, in dollars per million tokens

agents.title: Scanning agents
agents.subtitle: The agents of every customer, seen from the platform. A customer sees their own; here you see whether any of them is enrolled and has never connected.
agents.loadFailed: The agents could not be loaded
agents.emptyBody: No customer has registered a scanning agent yet. That is expected: an agent runs inside the customer network, so it gets enrolled when that customer deploys it.
agents.filtered: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} agents on this page.
agents.revokeFailed: The agent could not be revoked.
agents.revokeWarning: This agent's token is about to be cut. From now on it will not be able to claim jobs or report results.
agents.revokeInFlight: Whatever is already running is left with nobody to report to: the customer will see those scans as failed, and there is no way to recover them. Results already stored are kept.
agents.revokeReasonPlaceholder: why access to this customer's network is being cut
agents.revokeReasonHint: It goes to the audit log. Without it, six months from now there is no way to know why this customer stopped scanning.

pricing.title: Platform pricing
pricing.description: The only thing that decides what Mind Guard charges. Every change asks for a reason and is written to a history that cannot be edited.

states.error: The prices could not be loaded.

badges.fromCode: Bootstrap prices from code: the table is empty or could not be read
badges.live: This process already charges the new value

scalars.title: Base prices
scalars.help: All seven are saved in one operation. A scan already queued keeps the price it had when it was queued.

motive.label: Reason for the change
motive.help: Required. It is what tells a mistake correction apart from a deliberate price rise.

actions.error: The change could not be saved.

packs.title: Credit packs
packs.help: A deactivated pack stops being offered and its history stays intact. The credit amount is not editable: it is the pack's identity in the sales records, so to change it deactivate this one and create the new one.
packs.empty: No packs have been set up.

tiers.title: Volume discount ladder
tiers.help: The discount is a fraction: 0.10 is 10 %. The threshold is not editable, because moving it without moving its neighbours can leave two tiers overlapping or a gap between them.
tiers.empty: No tiers have been set up.

history.title: Change history
history.help: Read only, like the ledger and the evidence: what governed a charge is not corrected from the interface.
history.empty: No price has been changed yet.

operations.title: Platform operations
operations.description: Everything that runs, across all organizations. Here stuck jobs are stopped, containers left behind are cleaned up, and the money is returned when the failure is ours.

filters.soloColgados: Only the ones stuck or pending cleanup

states.error: The operations could not be loaded.
states.empty: There is nothing in this section.
states.notaRequired: Write a note before confirming the cancellation.

motive.label: Why it is being cancelled
motive.help: The reason decides whether the money is returned. Infrastructure failures return the reservation; a client cancellation does not, because the job was running.

actions.cancelledNoRefund: Cancelled. The job was running, so nothing is returned.
actions.error: The operation could not be completed.
